models.name: greek-english_porson_sophoclesplaysa05campgoog.mlmodel
models.description: Kraken model trained on Pogretra Porson data + Jebb's Sophocles commentary. Best for 18th-19th c. printed editions of classical texts. From the Ciaconna family (arXiv 2110.06817).

models.name: greek-german_serifs_sophokle1v3soph.mlmodel
models.description: Kraken model trained on Pogretra German-serifs data + Schneidewin's commentary. Good for 19th c. German-edition Greek texts. From the Ciaconna family (arXiv 2110.06817).

models.name: greek-german_serifs_bsb10234118.mlmodel
models.description: Kraken model trained on Pogretra German-serifs data + Lobeck's commentary. Good for 19th c. German-edition Greek texts. From the Ciaconna family (arXiv 2110.06817). DEFAULT: on page 31 of 'Πολυχρονιάδης Δεδούσης 2.0.pdf' (mid-20th c. Greek book, Didot-style face) it scored 0.038 CER, against 0.147 for sophokle1v3soph, 0.264 for porson, and 0.056 for Tesseract grc — which is what made it the default. Measured since on three further pages of the same book at 300 DPI it scores 0.078-0.194 CER (mean 0.126) against Tesseract's 0.107-0.185 (mean 0.143), winning the corpus on CER and every page on WER. Treat 0.08-0.19 as the working figure and 0.038 as one unusually clean page. See docs/ENGINE_ACCURACY.md.
